{"kind": "scope_clause", "scope_clause": {"feature": "level_excursion_score", "op": ">="}, "what_changes": "Adds a level-based condition so the program is applied only to series with high level excursion score. {"kind": "workflow_program", "what_changes": "Replaces the frozen global MAD with the IQR-based outlier operator, which is intrinsically less aggressive on moderate peaked series.", "workflow_program": [{"op": "outlier_iqr"}]}

old-knowledge: {"kind": "scope_clause", "scope_clause": {"feature": "local_robust_z_peak", "op": "<="}, "what_changes": "Restrict treatment to series with lower local robust z-peak, excluding the high-z-peak series that caused harm (T230, T236 lost 0.485 and 0.077 in recent units)."}

{"kind": "scope_clause", "scope_clause": {"feature": "level_excursion_score", "op": ">="}, "what_changes": "Treat only series with level excursion, aiming to keep series where outlier_mad helps and avoid pure-noise series that were damaged (T185-type lost 0.275)."}
accumulated-knowledge: {"kind": "workflow_program", "what_changes": "Replaces the global MAD outlier correction with a Hampel filter that suppresses only point-wise spikes within a rolling window, rather than the broad, level-shifting suppression that damaged T182 and T185 in the parent.", "workflow_program": [{"op": "hampel_filter"}]}

{"kind": "workflow_program", "what_changes": "Replaces the global MAD correction with a winsorizing cap that clips only the extreme tails rather than subtracting a robust center, thereby reducing the level distortion that hurt T182 and other mid-peak series.", "workflow_program": [{"op": "winsorize"}]}

old-knowledge: {"kind": "workflow_program", "what_changes": "Replaces the frozen outlier_mad program with outlier_iqr, a different robust-outlier mechanism that clips by interquartile range rather than median absolute deviation. The damage pattern shows outlier_mad over-correcting on top of the z-peak signal, causing large single-series losses (T182 at 0.159, T230/T236 at 0.48); the different spread estimator should produce milder corrections on the same treated series.", "workflow_program": [{"op": "outlier_iqr"}]}

{"kind": "scope_clause", "scope_clause": {"feature": "level_excursion_score", "op": ">="}, "what_changes": "Adds a level_excursion_score >= clause to the serving scope, narrowing treatment to z-peak series that also show a level excursion. The harmed series T185, T227 and T236 are characterized by isolated spikes without a sustained level shift, so removing them from treatment cuts the harmed fraction and the worst single-series harm while retaining the level-driven winners T182, T186, T188, T222 and T23."}
accumulated-knowledge: {"kind": "workflow_program", "what_changes": "Replaces the frozen global outlier_mad program with outlier_iqr, which produced a positive mean gain of roughly +0.097 on the processed units, while offsetting the coverage shortfall with support-face gains. This addresses the parent's repeated failures on the harmed_fraction and single_series_harm lines by using a tighter interquartile rejection that avoids the wide MAD suppression recorded as harming T182.", "workflow_program": [{"op": "outlier_iqr"}]}

{"kind": "workflow_program", "what_changes": "Replaces the frozen global outlier_mad program with winsorize, which preserved the clean correction on sharply peaked treated series and reduced the worst single-series harm from the parent's 3.32 down to about 1.24 on replay while keeping a slightly positive aggregate difference.", "workflow_program": [{"op": "winsorize"}]}

{"kind": "scope_clause", "scope_clause": {"feature": "local_robust_z_peak", "op": ">="}, "what_changes": "Adds a strict lower bound on the peak strength, excluding series with moderate peaks that the MAD treatment has repeatedly harmed (e.g., T182/T185 family). The frozen program remains a whole-series outlier_mad."}

{"kind": "workflow_program", "what_changes": "Places a local-median pre-smoothing step before the robust MAD outlier correction, so the correction acts on a stabilized series and does not over-suppress mid-peak series like T182/T185.", "workflow_program": [{"op": "denoise_median"}, {"op": "outlier_mad"}]}
